title: 从碎片化到融合：全模态嵌入综述与路线图
summary: 该立场论文指出嵌入模型研究因模态而碎片化，但对比学习、Transformer架构和粒度转变正推动各模态研究走向共同原则。作者提出覆盖、可比性、组合性三层能力框架，以及变换、对齐、联合嵌入三条统一路径，首次给出全模态嵌入的统一跨领域综述。
summary_en: This position paper argues that embedding research is fragmented by modality, yet contrastive learning, Transformers, and a granularity shift are driving convergence toward shared principles. It proposes a framework of coverage, comparability, and compositionality, with transformation, alignment, and joint embedding as paths to unification, offering the first unified cross-cutting survey of omnimodal embeddings.
